verified_facts.text: Amanemu is a ryokan-inspired onsen resort beside Ago Bay, amid the forested hills of Ise-Shima.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beside Ago Bay, amid the forested hills of Ise-Shima, the ryokan-inspired onsen resort of Amanemu

verified_facts.text: The cedar villas at Amanemu were designed by Kerry Hill.
The villas' humble construction pays homage to Ise Jingu, Japan's preeminent Shinto shrine.
verified_facts.excerpt: whose humble construction pays homage to Ise Jingū, Japan’s preeminent Shinto shrine

verified_facts.text: The spa has two private onsen bathing pavilions.
The spa has a thermal spring garden with daybeds.
Spa treatments incorporate local and seasonal ingredients, including pearl powder, seaweed, and herbs used in traditional kampo therapies.
verified_facts.excerpt: Treatments incorporate local and seasonal ingredients, including pearl powder, seaweed, and herbs and plants used in traditional kampo therapies

verified_facts.text: The signature Ise Jingu shrine breakfast is enjoyed overlooking Ago Bay and served in a handcrafted white wooden box.
verified_facts.excerpt: enjoyed while overlooking the serene Ago Bay and served in a handcrafted white wooden box

verified_facts.text: The Ama Hut Lunch offers a charcoal-grilled seafood lunch with stories from Ama divers and a visit to an Ama hut.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a fresh charcoal-grilled seafood lunch while listening to stories shared by Ama divers and visit an Ama hut.

verified_facts.text: The Sai-shi Mai ritual dance is performed at dusk on the Sunken Terrace against the backdrop of Ago Bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: At dusk, a mystical ritual called Sai-shi Mai is performed on the Sunken Terrace against the serene backdrop of Ago Bay.

verified_facts.text: Guests can take a half-day visit to the Naiku (Inner Shrine) of Ise Grand Shrine, followed by a stroll through the Oharaimachi district.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a special half-day visit to the revered Naikū (Inner Shrine) of Ise Grand Shrine, followed by a leisurely stroll through the charming Oharaimachi district

verified_facts.text: Amanemu offers a private sunset cruise on Ago Bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience the beauty of Ago Bay bathed in golden sunset hues on an elegant, private sunset cruise.

verified_facts.text: Round-trip transfers from Kashikojima Station are included.
Daily breakfast and dinner are included, excluding beverages.
The property is very secluded and a taxi is needed to get off property.

verified_facts.text: Wellness facilities include an outdoor swimming pool, steam rooms, a yoga studio and a fitness centre.
